Ranks Montgomery census tracts by adult diabetes prevalence from CDC PLACES descending, joining tract names and retaining the adult population denominator, with geoid last for mapping.
sql:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT
    tractfips,
    CAST(diabetes_crudeprev AS DOUBLE) AS adult_diabetes_prevalence,
    CAST(totalpop18plus AS DOUBLE) AS totalpop18plus,
    CAST(totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) AS totalpopulation
  FROM session.fw_3cbb4c_m1_cdc
)
SELECT
  tr.name,
  c.adult_diabetes_prevalence,
  c.totalpop18plus,
  c.totalpopulation,
  tr.geoid AS geoid
FROM c
JOIN fw_pg.tracts tr ON tr.geoid = c.tractfips
ORDER BY c.adult_diabetes_prevalence DESC NULLS LAST, tr.name ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 200
